data.explanation: This is an invoice from an online shop for a hedge trimmer and shipping, bought on account (Kauf auf Rechnung). The total of €134.98 is due within 7 days of the invoice date (17 December 2025), without any deduction. Pay the amount by bank transfer to the IBAN shown, quoting the invoice number BV-7741203 as the payment reference, by the deadline shown. If the amount stays unpaid, the seller may send reminders or additional dunning fees, though none are mentioned in this letter.
